a.text: Being upfront before anything happens: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of operating first means we both very likely end round 1 at 0 cells and fail. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to secure one unit right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'd rather tell you than surprise you. If you also take, the split is random. If you see a better plan, tell me, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
